# Signaturizer v1 — Development Summary

## Status: COMPLETE (12/12 tasks done, 0 failed)

## Commits
1. feat: scaffold Electron + Svelte + Tailwind project with electron-forge
2. feat: add core libraries and UI shell (Wave 2) — 145 tests
3. feat: add UI components — camera modal, signature dropdown, placement system (Wave 3) — 190 tests
4. feat: wire full integration — camera flow, PDF stamping, export (Wave 4) — 221 tests
5. feat: add keyboard shortcuts, UI polish, and README — 228 tests

## Final Stats
- 228 tests across 10 test files
- 5 git commits
- All core features implemented

## Architecture
- Main process: window management, IPC for file dialogs and userData
- Renderer: Svelte 5 with runes ($state, $props, $effect)
- Libraries: image-processor, signature-store, pdf-viewer, pdf-exporter (all pure JS, testable)
- Components: App, Toolbar, PdfViewer, CameraModal, SignatureDropdown, SignaturePlacement

## Key Decisions Made During Development
- Adapter pattern for signature-store (fs adapter vs memory adapter for testing)
- PDF coordinate system: canvas top-left → PDF bottom-left conversion in SignaturePlacement
- targetZoom prop pattern for syncing Toolbar zoom with PdfViewer
- Per-page dimension map for multi-page export
- Original imageData stored on placed signatures to prevent tint compounding
